name: HDFS 5004
title: Mixed Methods in Social and Behavioral Research
description: The evolution of mixed methods research and its place in contemporary social science, including the sequential and concurrent use of mixed methods in experimental, quasi-experimental, and observational designs. Readings, class discussion, and practical exercises will focus on specific designs, methods of data collection, and analysis to identify and evaluate meaning and structure in thought, behavior, and culture.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Human Development and Family Sciences, others with instructor consent.
